start: Menu, Your gym, Help and feedback, an online gym, signed in as the owner

steps.action: Open Help and feedback
user_sees: Title 'Help and feedback'
'Ask a question and get an answer at once. Or tell us what works, what is hard, or what you want next. Hindi or English. On a phone you can tap the microphone on your keyboard to speak.'
A box 'Your message' and a 'Send' button that cannot be pressed while the box is empty
'Your questions' with 'Questions you send from this browser show here, with their answers.'
must_not: The page in the demo gym's menu

steps.action: Type 'How do I renew a member?' and tap 'Send'
user_sees: The button says 'Sending…' and the line 'Sending. The answer usually takes a few seconds.'
The question shows at once under 'Your questions' with 'Waiting for the answer. It usually takes a few seconds.'
must_not: Two messages sent by a second tap
The typed text lost before the answer comes

steps.action: Wait for the answer
user_sees: The answer in a box with 'Answer written by AI from our help pages.' and 'Did this solve it?' with 'Yes' and 'No'
The message box is empty again
The same answer under the question in 'Your questions'
must_not: An answer about another gym's data
The answer shown as if a person wrote it

steps.action: Tap 'Yes'
user_sees: 'Great! Glad it helped.'
'You said this solved it.' under the question in 'Your questions'
must_not: The Yes/No buttons still offered after the choice

start: Help and feedback opened a day later in the same browser ('Your questions' history)

steps.action: Open Help and feedback
user_sees: Every question sent from this browser, newest first, each with its day, its answer and 'You said this solved it.' or 'You said this did not solve it. The MettleUp team will reply here.'
must_not: Questions missing that were sent from this browser
More than the kept number shown with no word

steps.action: Look at a question the MettleUp team answered
user_sees: A box 'Reply from the MettleUp team' with a 'New' mark and the reply
must_not: The 'New' mark on a reply that was opened before
A reply meant for another person's question

steps.action: Leave the page and come back
user_sees: The same reply without the 'New' mark
must_not: The reply gone

steps.action: Tap 'Send' with an empty box or only spaces
user_sees: The button cannot be pressed
must_not: An empty message sent

steps.action: Turn the internet off, type a message, tap 'Send'
user_sees: 'Couldn't send. Check your internet and try again. Your message is still here.'
The typed text is still in the box
must_not: 'Thanks! We read every message.' for a message that did not go
The question left as 'Waiting for the answer' for ever under 'Your questions'

steps.action: Paste 3,000 letters into the box
user_sees: The box holds the first 2,000 letters
must_not: The rest dropped with no word that the message was cut

steps.action: Send a question when the gym has no AI credits left
user_sees: An answer taken from the help pages
A button 'Open AI Assistant'
must_not: 'Did this solve it?' missing with no other way to say the answer did not help
An error in place of an answer

start: Help and feedback, an AI answer just shown

steps.action: Tap 'No' under 'Did this solve it?'
user_sees: 'Got it. We reply as soon as we can.'
Under the question: 'You said this did not solve it. The MettleUp team will reply here.'
must_not: The choice lost after a refresh
A way to tap both Yes and No

steps.action: Type the first letter of a new message
user_sees: The old answer box goes away; the old question and answer stay under 'Your questions'
must_not: The old answer shown under the new message

steps.action: Come back after the MettleUp team replied
user_sees: 'Reply from the MettleUp team' with 'New', once
must_not: No sign anywhere that a reply came while the page was closed

steps.action: Look for a way to delete a question from 'Your questions'
user_sees: There is none; the list stays in this browser
must_not: A question removed from the list while its reply is still to come

start: One desk computer used by the owner and by staff, both signing in to the same browser

steps.action: The owner sends a question, signs out; a staff person signs in and opens Help and feedback
user_sees: 'Your questions' shows only what this person sent
must_not: The owner's questions, AI answers and MettleUp's replies shown to staff
The owner's 'delete our gym' request (gym name, code and phone) listed for staff to read
Another gym's questions after a different gym signs in on this browser

steps.action: Send a message and check what goes with it
user_sees: Only the message, the app, the browser's name, the screen and this browser's random id go to MettleUp
must_not: Member names or phone numbers added to the message by the app
